description: FR-HR-003 -- one movement of one leave balance. Written only by knit360_core.hr.leave_ledger.

fields.label: Employee
fields.description: FR-HR-001: whose balance this entry moves.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: FR-HR-003: the company the balance belongs to.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: FR-HR-003: the date the entry takes effect.

fields.label: Leaves
fields.description: FR-HR-003: days, signed. Positive grants balance, negative consumes it. The balance is the sum of these and is never stored anywhere.

fields.label: Leave Period
fields.description: FR-HR-003: the period the entry falls in.

fields.label: From Date
fields.description: FR-HR-003: first day covered, for an application.

fields.label: To Date
fields.description: FR-HR-003: last day covered, for an application.

fields.label: Voucher Type
fields.description: FR-HR-003: the doctype that caused this entry.

fields.label: Voucher No
fields.description: FR-HR-003: the document that caused this entry.

fields.label: Cancelled
fields.description: FR-HR-003: set on both the original and its reversal when a voucher is cancelled. Nothing is ever deleted.

name: KNIT 360 Leave Ledger Entry
